confidence_notes: Food anchors use Kotor prices shown by Numbeo and a July 2026 local guide. Hostel averages are based on a small sample, and lodging prices vary sharply by season. Wine follows the guide's shared local beer/wine range; cocktail is estimated at about 2.5 times the local draft beer price.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy used; estimates are based on Kotor-specific prices.
